# Numbers sheet — first review

*SIMULATED DATA. Generated by `scripts/build_results_pack.py`. If asked "how accurate is it", read the number.*

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Tests | **437 pytest tests**, all passing (exit code checked directly) |
| Data loss (Day 2, 8 h at 100×) | **49,979 published + 13 injected = 49,992 received = 49,979 stored + 13 rejected** — zero loss |
| Ingest throughput | **173.6 msg/s** sustained (Day 2); 156.1 msg/s over the 7-day run (1,071,656 messages, zero loss) |
| Worker localisation | **96.4%** of on-site worker-minutes in the right zone, median latency **30 s** (7 days: 96.3%) |
| Exposure maths | 12 hand-verified noise cases + 4 Schedule XXVIII rows; single-zone consistency residual **0.0 dB** |
| Forecast skill vs persistence, noise | t+30: RF **+0.81** (seasonal +0.77); t+60: RF +0.74 — **does not beat** seasonal +0.77 |
| Break-free windows, noise | RF **+0.56 / +0.62** vs seasonal +0.39 / +0.51 (t+30 / t+60) — skill beyond the timetable |
| Forecast skill, dust / heat | PM2.5 XGBoost **+0.38 / +0.43**; WBGT +0.13 / +0.21 (seasonal worse than persistence) |
| 90 dBA crossings warned | **36/36**, median lead **17–18.5 min**, false alarms **5–12%** (seasonal baseline 36–42%) |
| Exposure, 140 worker-days | **90% NIOSH / 40% India** above 100% dose; coverage 99.1%, unaccounted 0.15% |
| Risk index (deterministic, design choice) | High 110, Low 14, Medium 16; median 72/100 — a loud mill, not a calibration fault |
| Risk index, worst single component | Shown beside the composite; worst band above the composite band on **24 of 140** worker-days (components are not on commensurable scales) |
| Exceedance warning where it matters (Z2, near 90 dBA) | **Barely beats chance**: `crossing` PR-AUC **0.22 / 0.22** vs base rate 0.18; false alarms on 44% / 53% of quiet minutes. Borderline group (Z2, Z3, Z6): 0.18 vs 0.08 |
| Exceedance classification, pooled | `above`: prevalence 40%, PR-AUC 0.97 vs persistence 0.67. `crossing` 0.83 / 0.84 — driven by always-loud zones (trivial restarts) and the office; not the result |
| Objective 6 ablation | **Negative answer.** Machine + worker data add +0.017 / +0.028 noise skill with target lags, and only **+0.014 / +0.014** without them (CIs exclude 0; about 0.1 dB). Redundant with the timetable: a model with **no noise input** reaches **+0.76 / +0.77** → sensor-failure resilience |
| Machine condition | M5 flagged on day **2.08** (EWMA) / 2.12 (isolation forest); **no healthy machine alarmed**; healthy false-positive rate 0.02% vs 1.03% |
| Deep learning (GRU, optional) | Noise skill **+0.52 / +0.68** vs XGBoost on the same features +0.76 / +0.79 — no advantage; the engineered lags already carry the temporal structure |

**Say first:** simulated data · zone-weighted presence, not personal measurement · WBGT approximate (underestimate) · dust indicative · the index is a weighted design choice, not a clinical model.
